newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fujitsu launches pocket mobile network device.
newsitem.headline: Fujitsu launches pocket mobile network device.

text.p: Fujitsu Ltd said on Tuesday it launched in Japan a pocket-sized computer device that allows mobile networking.

The Intertop, equipped with a color liquid crystal display (LCD) and a 33.6 Kbps modem, offers electronic mail and facsimile functions and the exchange of data with personal computers, Fujitsu said in a statement.
The device, measuring 29 mm by 210 mm by 149.5 mm and weighing 750 grams, will be priced at 128,000 yen.
Shipments will start on June 12, with a yearly sales target of 100,000 units, the company said.
